content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Using Bitcoin for payments in the digital downloads space allows creators to bypass traditional payment processors that impose high fees and restrictions. Platforms like Gumroad charge 10% per sale, which can significantly eat into profits. In contrast, using Bitcoin through NOWPayments incurs only a 0.5% fee, making it a viable option for digital creators, especially those with high sales volumes. The fee difference can retain more revenue for creators, proving that infrastructure choice directly impacts bottom lines.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for accepting Bitcoin payments involves several components working seamlessly together. First, digital products are hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the Bitcoin transaction, converting the price into USD at the time of the sale. Once confirmed on-chain, an automated webhook triggers product delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This system is designed to be efficient, secure, and completely under the control of the seller, eliminating reliance on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators who have been locked out of conventional payment solutions. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, or creative assets like fonts and templates, this system empowers you to maintain full ownership and control of your sales process. It is particularly beneficial for creators in regions facing financial isolation, as it provides a reliable and low-cost means to monetize digital products without the need for a middleman.
NOWPayments offers a seamless crypto payment solution with only a 0.5% fee.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this infrastructure include hosting solutions like GitHub Pages for product display, NOWPayments for handling Bitcoin transactions, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivering digital downloads. Each component plays a crucial role: hosting provides a platform for your store; NOWPayments ensures seamless payment processing, and file delivery systems guarantee that customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation. Together, these elements form a robust digital commerce stack that is both scalable and efficient.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, choose a hosting solution such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to set up your store. Next, integrate NOWPayments for Bitcoin processing to handle transactions. Store your digital products on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to enable automated delivery. Finally, consider purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to access all necessary blueprints and templates for building your digital commerce stack efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
By choosing this infrastructure, you regain control over your digital sales.

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.

Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for automatic file delivery to customers. Load your products into the system, ensuring everything is tested and operational.
